useCuratedList.title: Use the curated company list
useCuratedList.description: Fetch every company in our verified registry (166+ companies, ~14,000 open roles). Turn this off if you want to name specific companies below.

companies.title: Specific companies (optional)
companies.description: Company job-board slugs, e.g. "stripe" or "ramp". Usually the company name in lowercase. Leave the ATS blank and we'll work out which system they use. Overrides the curated list.

maxJobs.title: Maximum jobs to return
maxJobs.description: Hard cap on results. This is your main cost control — you are charged per job returned.

remoteOnly.title: Remote roles only
remoteOnly.description: Only return roles that are remote or remote-eligible. Note: some ATSs (notably Ashby) flag most roles 'remote-eligible' while still listing an office location. Every record carries both `remote` (the location text actually says remote) and `remoteEligible` (the company's own flag), so you can filter more strictly yourself.

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Only roles whose title contains one of these (case-insensitive). e.g. "engineer", "designer".

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: Only roles whose location contains one of these (case-insensitive). e.g. "London", "New York".

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only roles posted in the last N days. Roles with no posting date are kept.

includeDescription.title: Include full job description
includeDescription.description: Turn off for a much smaller, faster dataset when you only need titles, locations, and links.
